class.name: LaserSpawner2D
class.brief_description: Fires lasers along patterns: one [LaserVolley2D] per shot, a beam per pattern slot.
class.description: A [PatternSpawner2D] that fires lasers ([member laser_data]) instead of bullets. Everything about where and when to fire works exactly like a [BulletSpawner2D]: the pattern sources and their preview (the arrows show the laser's length), the Transform subgroup, auto fire, bursts, telegraph, pattern lists ([code]laser_data[/code] is their payload key), spin, Path2D movement, time scale, [method PatternSpawner2D.shoot_from] and the Graze and Sound groups (beams graze by their distance to the targets; sound entries fire On Shot, On Telegraph, On Hit, On Bounce for a wall stop, On Graze, On Graze Exit, On Lifetime Over when a laser finishes, On Flight at the tip). While [member LaserData2D.follow_spawner] is on, the muzzles ride this spawner: its moves, its spin and its teleports. Track and Lock On lasers aim at what the Laser Targeting group finds. The laser signals fire on this spawner while it lives (never on the factory; grazes then bubble to the factory too); [member orphaned_lasers] decides what its lasers do when it is freed. Bullets can fire lasers too: point a [BulletSpawner2D]'s [member BulletSpawner2D.emitter_spawner_path] at a laser spawner.

method.name: debug_explain_features
method.description: Returns one sentence per group: what a shot fires, the targeting, graze and sound.

method.name: end_live_lasers
method.description: Ends every laser this spawner fired (fading, or at once). Returns how many.

method.name: get_live_laser_count
method.description: Returns how many of its lasers fire now.

method.name: get_live_lasers
method.description: Returns every [LaserVolley2D] this spawner fired that still fires.

method.name: resolve_laser_targets
method.description: Returns the targets the Laser Targeting group finds now: [Node2D]s, or one [Vector2] for the Mouse and Global Position sources.

method.name: retarget_live_lasers
method.description: Gives every live Track / Lock On laser of this spawner the targets resolved now (each beam the nearest). Returns how many lasers it retargeted.

members.member: What a shot fires (see [LaserData2D]). Edits reach the lasers that are firing; the preview beams follow its [member LaserData2D.length].
Node Group and Node Path: how often the live Track / Lock On lasers pick their targets again (each beam the nearest), in seconds. 0 = only when fired.
Node Group and Node Path: only targets also in this group count (empty = no filter).
Node Group: the group whose members the beams aim at (each beam its nearest member). Members pass the same target filter as homing and graze, never this spawner or its children.
Node Path: the [Node2D] every beam aims at.
Global Position: the point every beam aims at. Must be finite.
Where Track and Lock On lasers find their targets (see [enum LaserTargetSource]). Lasers aiming along the pattern ignore it.
Soft cap: while this many of its lasers fire, shots are skipped ([signal PatternSpawner2D.volley_skipped] with [code]over_budget[/code]). 0 = no limit.
What the lasers of this spawner do when it is freed (see [enum OrphanedLasers]).

signal.name: laser_finished
signal.description: One of its lasers finished (see [signal BulletFactory2D.laser_finished]).

signal.name: laser_fired
signal.description: A shot fired [param laser] (its beams are armed, targeted and in place): shot number [param shot_index].

signal.name: laser_graze_exited
signal.description: Beam [param beam_index] of [param laser] left the zone [param zone] of [param target] after grazing it ([param deepest_ring_index] = the innermost ring it touched). [param target] is [code]null[/code] for a point target. Bubbles to [signal BulletFactory2D.laser_graze_exited].

signal.name: laser_grazed
signal.description: Beam [param beam_index] of [param laser] grazed ring [param ring_index] of [param zone] around [param target] (its distance to the beam, plus half the width with [member BulletGrazeZone2D.count_bullet_size]). Once per ring per laser life, or again after leaving with [constant BulletGrazeZone2D.REGRAZE_AFTER_EXIT]. Bubbles to [signal BulletFactory2D.laser_grazed].

constants.constant: They fire on silently (no one hears their signals).
They fire on and signal on the factory.
No targets: Track and Lock On lasers keep their pattern direction.
Each beam aims at the nearest member of [member laser_target_group].
Every beam aims at the node at [member laser_target_path].
Every beam aims at the cursor (read every frame).
